text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm seeing ~0.3% of requests routed to v1 even after the header shim landed in front of the router. Not constant, spikes around bursts.

marta: hmm. Is that the X-API-Version shim or the legacy Accept header?

alex: X-API-Version. We added a shim that rewrites v1 -> v2-compatible header for the router so older clients keep working, but route-affinity seems to ignore it for a subset of connections.

ken: could be a loadbalancer sticky-session mismatch — if the LB routed initial SYN to a host without shim, subsequent proxied requests might hit a different path. Any logs?

alex: Pasted the minimal trace below — request shows X-API-Version: 1, shim rewrote to v2, but router debug shows fallback lookup as if header absent: 

```
X-API-Version: 1 -> shim set: X-API-Version: v2
router: lookup route header: none
router: fallback route: legacy-v1
```

sam: can you share the exact shim code/config? maybe the header name collision with some proxy stripping? Also is quota mapping using raw header or canonicalized value?

alex: shim is in ingress-proxy v0.42. config snippet: 

```
headers:
  X-API-Version:
    rewrite: "v2"
    preserve-original: true
```

marta: quota service ingests the raw pre-shim header today (legacy behavior). We intentionally left it that way to preserve billing semantics for v1 customers. That might explain why quotas show v1 tokens while router thinks v2.

ken: that's a problem — inconsistent view between router and quota/telemetry. For rollout we need atomicity: routing, quota, and telemetry must agree on version.

alex: Agreed. Options: 1) make shim happen earlier (before quota and router) so all downstream see v2; 2) have router consult both header and shim metadata; 3) emit telemetry mapping event to reconcile.

sam: option 1 is easiest but risky for auditing. Option 3 safer: emit compat.mapping events like `compat.version_mapped` with request id. Observability can aggregate mismatches and we can use A/B to decide.

marta: We also need to watch unit costs — if quota still charges as v1 while router uses v2 model, customers hit weird invoices. That's a blocker for enabling shim by default.

observability-bot: Canary deployed: ingress-proxy v0.42 -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-15T16:21:10Z :rocket:

alex: Can we add a lightweight flag in router that, when set, treats shimmed requests as the canonical version for routing + quota decisions? It could be a temporary 'compat_affinity' mode during rollout.

ken: We already have per-route flags. We could add `compat_affinity=true` guarded behind a feature flag and enable for the canary cohort only. Router would then prefer shim_value over raw header for affinity cookies.

marta: Need corresponding dashboard slices: a) percent mismatched (raw vs shim), b) quota charge deltas by customer, c) errors attributable to routing mismatch. Sam/observability, can you add panels?

sam: Yep — creating a small dashboard in console -> rollout_cohorts -> v1-to-v2_shim. Will include metrics: compat.mapping.count, compat.mismatch.count, quota.charge.delta. ETA 3h.

alex: In the short term I'm going to limit the shim rollout to read-only endpoints (no quota changes) and enable observability events. If mismatch rate <0.1% after 24h we can consider expanding.

marta: Also add a recovery plan: if mismatch >1% we revert shim immediately and open an incident. Add a quick /rollout revert playbook.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout updated: ingress-proxy v0.42 -> cohort tag="canary-17" 10% (compat_affinity=off)

ken: One more edge: KV cache keys use original header fingerprint. If shim changes semantics, KV cache hits drop for long-tail clients. We'll need to ensure cache key normalization includes shim mapping when compat_affinity=true.

alex: Good call. I'll follow up with a small patch to cache key builder to accept an optional mapped_version param.

marta: Thanks. We'll regroup after Sam's dashboard is up and 24h of metrics. If everything looks good, we can flip compat_affinity for the rest of the rollout and update quota pipeline to canonicalize on the router's canonical version.

sam: Dashboard created and shared in #dashboards with a link: https://console.redwood/dashboards/rollout/v1-v2-shim. Added alert: compat.mismatch.rate > 0.5% for 15m -> paging to eng-platform.

alex: Perfect. Leaving logs on for extra 48h. I'll post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
